capabilities: Preserve the active light/dark palette in native PDF exports
Repeat content padding on every exported PDF page
Adjust top, right, bottom, and left margins from 0 to 40 mm
Restore native export behavior by disabling the plugin
disambiguation: Not a PDF exporter or new export flow; it only styles the output of Obsidian's built-in Export to PDF command.
extras: Not in the community catalog; manual installation from Release downloads is required. Repeated page padding needs Chromium 130+ and app version 1.9.0+; older engines keep original pagination and show a settings warning. Tested only on Windows with the Border theme; other themes, landscape, oversized elements, and dynamic embeds need separate testing. No network requests; the temporary reading-view clone used for color sampling is removed synchronously, including on error.
intentEvidence: No system print dialog or replacement export command is added.
problem: Obsidian's native PDF export follows the OS color scheme instead of the reading palette, and its page margins clip full-bleed backgrounds supplied by themes and snippets.
summary: Export-styling bridge that carries the active Obsidian light/dark palette and per-page content padding into the built-in Export to PDF output.
